claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_ritual_casting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Ritual Adept grants the ability to ritual-cast any spell in the spellbook with the Ritual tag, without preparation. This is a categorical casting-mode enabler, not a per-spell access grant. The existing grant_spell_access atom requires a specific spellId and a SpellAccessMode — it cannot express a rule that applies to an open-ended, tag-filtered set of spells drawn from a named source (the spellbook). A new atom is needed to capture: (a) the categorical scope (Ritual-tagged spells), (b) the source constraint (must be in spellbook), and (c) the derived casting requirement (must read from book).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can cast any spell as a Ritual if that spell has the Ritual tag and the spell is in your spellbook. You needn't have the spell prepared, but you must read from the book to cast a spell in this way.
